text:
𝗗𝗘 𝗦𝗜𝗟𝗩𝗔 𝗗𝗘𝗙𝗜𝗔𝗡𝗧! 🇱🇰

Sri Lanka 221/4 at Day 3 lunch in Rawalpindi, still 14 short of avoiding the follow-on (235).
Dhananjaya de Silva is 87*.

Can they escape? 👇

#PAKvSL #Cricket

👉 Follow-on bachane ke liye 235 chahiye, yaani abhi 14 run aur
👉 Dhananjaya de Silva 87* pe, 38 pe catch drop hua tha
👉 Pakistan ne 434/9 pe declare kiya tha

Sri Lanka follow-on bacha payega? Comment karo 👇
